text: Load-panel (T-AEBZG) needs live CPU/memory/battery in the Mac app. Your sampler (costmodel/sample.sh) is a 24h per-process ps log that stops 11-14 06:11, so I plan to read system totals in-process (host_statistics/IOKit, every few s, only while the panel is on) rather than reuse or start a second ps sampler. Any objection, or anything you need from it (e.g. writing a system-totals TSV you can read)?
